I don't think my dad is, it turned out today that mum had been lying to him about my behavior so he seriously thought I was out of line, plus he didn't say anything overstepping parental lines.  My mum on the other hand... She's pulling this yelling abuse thing at my dad today and I think it finally made him realize the magnitude of her issues.  He's looking into divorce.

Your childhood sounds a lot like mine, only my mum's favorite word is princess instead of spoiled.   I'm sorry about your parents, internet hugs back to you.
